entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I... I think I need to return something. I have this jersey, and it's just not right. The website was so confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I get your name and email address?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, S-A-R-A-H, Miller. The email is S.Miller@webmail.com.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your recent order for the Aero-Pro Jersey. I see it was delivered about 16 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?

Oh, a preference, I think? It's the wrong size. It's just so incredibly tight, I can barely zip it up. I thought I followed the size chart, but... I don't know. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like to exchange it for a bigger size if possible.
Of course, I can absolutely help with that. I understand sizing can be tricky online. Let me just check the policy for you... one moment.

Okay, thanks for your patience, Sarah. So, that jersey is one of our standard apparel items, which means it falls under our 10-day return and exchange policy. Since you received it 16 days ago, you are unfortunately outside the window to get that sorted out.
Oh, really? That's a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. We can definitely process an exchange for the next size up. And since you're a VIP member and had some trouble with our sizing chart, I'm going to waive the return shipping fee for you and add a 15% discount to your account for your next apparel purchase, just to make sure you get the perfect fit next time.
Wow, that's... that's so helpful! Thank you so much, Alex. I really appreciate it.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. You'll receive an email in the next few minutes with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Just pack up the jersey that's too tight and send it back to us, and we'll ship out the new size as soon as we see the return has been scanned by the carrier. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've made this so easy. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
